baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restrictive construction around بشر مثلنا makes shared visible humanity the stated reason to reject the envoys.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speakers reduce the envoys to exposed human appearance, convert resemblance into exhaustive identity, and then treat the absence of visible difference as proof that no transmission from above occurred.

activation_trace.role: The visible skin or surface supplies the perceptual level at which the envoys are classified.
General resemblance is assigned the stronger role of exhaustive equivalence.
Delivery from a higher source is what the surface-equivalence inference rules out.

changed_reading.before: You are humans resembling us.
changed_reading.after: Because nothing visibly distinguishes your human surface from ours, you cannot be carriers of anything delivered from beyond our level.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence وما أنزل الرحمن من شيء turns شيء under negation into an unrestricted cancellation of content.
baseline_models.mechanism: Descent is treated as delivery, while شيء names whatever can be known or reported; the partitive negation erases every possible delivered item before evidence about any particular item can be heard.

activation_trace.role: The branch contributes the delivery of a book, command, benefit, or affliction.
The maximally general knowable or reportable item makes the denial total.
Merciful beneficence is named as the alleged source whose giving is categorically denied.
Attributing falsehood to the envoys closes the denial by discrediting its only witnesses.

changed_reading.before: No unspecified thing was sent down.
changed_reading.after: Nothing whatsoever capable of being known, reported, or received can have come from the Merciful, so your report is false by definition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قالوا opens an utterance whose final act is to assign كذب to the addressees.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speech does more than describe a fact: it manufactures a public status for the envoys. Because قول also carries the possibility of saying or attributing what did not occur, the charge is structurally capable of mirroring the fault it alleges.

activation_trace.role: An inward judgment is externalized as articulated public speech.
The branch keeps open the risk that speech attributes to another what was not so.
The predicate functions as an act of assigning the envoys to the category of liars.

changed_reading.before: They reported that the envoys were lying.
changed_reading.after: They publicly imposed the status of liar on the envoys, in an utterance that may itself be an unsupported attribution.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence assembles recitation, perfected judgment, a sent carrier, a straight course, and تنزيل from the Mighty-Merciful. Descent therefore presents as an ordered installation of guidance into a traversable human course, not merely a visible object falling from the sky.

activation_trace.role: The denied act can mean placing something in its fitting station or rank.
Recitation supplies the communicative content that the sequence identifies.
Perfection and secure ordering characterize the recited content.
The messenger branch supplies a commissioned carrier rather than a different species of being.
A path gives the installed communication a functional route.
Straightness contributes calibrated alignment rather than visible otherness.
تنزيل explicitly names the ordered placing that 36:15 denies.
Merciful beneficence joins the same source-root named in the denial.

structural_cues: 36:2-5 is an uninterrupted specification chain ending in تنزيل العزيز الرحيم before the rejection scene begins.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitation, wisdom, messenger, path, straightness, and تنزيل in sequence; I infer that their sequence models descent as ordered placement into a route. A live alternative is that the sequence only identifies source and genre without redefining descent spatially.

changed_reading.before: No object has visibly descended from the Merciful.
changed_reading.after: No divinely ordered communication has been installed among us through a commissioned human carrier and a straight course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The verdict from visible human sameness is placed inside a sequence of constrained necks, barriers on both sides, covering, failed sight, and a contrasting response to the unseen. The accusation becomes a product of surface-bound access rather than a neutral assessment of all available reality.

activation_trace.role: The human surface is the only evidentiary layer the speakers acknowledge.
The lying verdict is the output whose perceptual conditions are re-evaluated.
A statement fixed as matching reality contrasts with the villagers' contrary status assignment.
A restraining collar supplies bodily fixation that prevents free reorientation.
Paired closures block access from both temporal-spatial directions.
A covering over the perceiver explains why only exposed surfaces register.
Failure of ocular sight marks the limit of the villagers' evidence.
Reality hidden from eyes supplies the contrasting domain to which a receptive hearer responds.

structural_cues: 36:7-11 moves from nonbelief through blocked orientation and sight to a hearer who responds to the Merciful in the unseen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily and visual obstruction followed by receptivity to the unseen; I infer an epistemic arrow from occlusion to the surface-only verdict. The obstruction may alternatively portray a consequence of prior refusal rather than its cause.

changed_reading.before: Their shared visible humanity proves the envoys' report false.
changed_reading.after: The charge of falsehood reveals a perceiver confined to visible surfaces and unable or unwilling to register an unseen source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus erases any descended شيء, while 36:12 places every شيء, including residual آثار, inside writing, enumeration, and a guiding record. The denied content is reclassified from an absent object to something knowable through its transmitted and remaining traces.

activation_trace.role: The general knowable or reportable item is placed under total negation.
Writing fixes what occurred into an authoritative determination.
A remaining mark makes an absent source inferable.
Total enclosure directly opposes the focus's totalizing exclusion.
The same general item-root is now included in exhaustive knowledge.
Enumeration makes every item and trace individually accountable.
The guiding record gathers the enumerated traces under a legible reference.

structural_cues: 36:12's كل شيء immediately precedes the parable whose villagers say من شيء in 36:15.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed quantifier frames and a trace-record mechanism; I infer that 36:12 pre-emptively destabilizes the erasure in 36:15. Alternatively, 36:12 may state divine knowledge generally without targeting the later denial's semantics.

changed_reading.before: There is no descended thing to inspect.
changed_reading.after: They erase the message from the class of knowable things even though transmitted speech and its آثار can enter an exhaustive record.

context_deltas.mechanism: Their claim of likeness occurs inside a scene explicitly struck as a likeness. The villagers use resemblance to close inquiry, but the composition uses their very response as a repeatable example; meanwhile multiple envoys are reinforced rather than made nonhuman.

activation_trace.role: Resemblance is the villagers' stated disqualifier.
The scene is deliberately rendered and displayed as an example.
The same root now marks a portable parable rather than identity between persons.
Commission and message persist across more than one human carrier.
Rejection is already enacted before the explicit liar charge in the focus.
Reinforcement increases corroboration without changing the envoys' species.
A third completes the reinforcing set that the villagers still dismiss.

structural_cues: 36:13 labels the coming scene a مَثَل before 36:15 supplies مِثْلُنَا; 36:14 multiplies and reinforces the envoys.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the enclosing parable label and the embedded resemblance claim; I infer a meta-level reversal in which their analogy becomes an example of recurrent rejection. The outer مَثَل need not lexically redefine inner مِثْلُنَا, so this remains a framing effect.

changed_reading.before: Resemblance to ordinary humans ends the case against messengerhood.
changed_reading.after: Their misuse of resemblance becomes the very repeatable example through which later hearers can recognize the rejection pattern.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah later repeats a true but bounded no-descent statement: no heavenly army was sent down, nor was one needed; a single cry produces the effect. This preserves the syntax while correcting its scope, separating absence of visible reinforcement from absence of divine action or commission.

activation_trace.role: The villagers deny every form of delivered intervention.
The unrestricted item-word makes their scope absolute.
The repeated descent-root is explicitly limited to a denied military delivery.
A mutually supporting host specifies what did not descend.
The sky supplies the literal upper origin expected for visible reinforcement.
A frightening cry replaces the imagined need for a descending host.
Singularity emphasizes the minimal means sufficient for the result.
Life and motion fall still without a visible army's arrival.

structural_cues: 36:28 closely echoes وما أنزلنا ... من ... من السماء, then 36:29 supplies a non-descending single event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later bounded negation and its sufficient alternative means; I infer that it exposes the focus's invalid expansion from no visible army-like descent to no communication at all. The later statement concerns punishment, so the correction is analogical rather than a direct dialogue reply.

changed_reading.before: If no extraordinary thing visibly descends, the Merciful has sent nothing.
changed_reading.after: They confuse the absence of a visible heavenly force with the absence of commission, although divine action need not arrive as descending spectacle.

context_deltas.mechanism: The moon is measured into منازل and all bodies move in an orbit without collision. The descent-root thus participates in calibrated stations and recurrent traversal, strengthening a reading of revelation as measured placement and sequencing rather than crude vertical transport.

activation_trace.role: The focus's denied descent can carry placement into a proper station.
Deliberate measurement supplies the ordering principle for the stations.
منازل realizes the same root as assigned locations in a measured course.
Return after departure makes stationing cyclical rather than a one-time fall.
The celestial course holds distinct bodies in ordered motion.
Flowing movement connects the stations into a functioning sequence.

structural_cues: 36:38-40 repeatedly couples determination, station, non-overtaking, orbit, and motion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured celestial stations under the descent-root; I infer a formal analogy to measured revelation. The live alternative is that منازل is an independent astronomical derivative with no intended bearing on 36:15's أنزل.

changed_reading.before: Descent would have to be a conspicuous object crossing vertically into the village.
changed_reading.after: Descent may be the measured placing of communication into appointed human, temporal, and linguistic stations.

context_deltas.mechanism: The carried descendants in a loaded vessel are followed by created things من مثله that people ride; rescue from drowning is then named mercy. In this transport system, likeness does not cancel function: matching form makes a carrier usable by those it carries.

activation_trace.role: The villagers use same-kind resemblance to disqualify the carriers.
Visible bearing supplies the carrier function.
The vessel is a medium that moves its passengers through a hostile element.
Full loading makes carriage, not visual difference, the decisive property.
Likeness explicitly belongs to what is created for riding.
Riding realizes the useful relation enabled by the like-made carrier.
Divine willing controls whether the transport relation continues.
Rescue defines the functional outcome a carrier or helper must achieve.
Mercy names the preserving relation realized through the transport sequence.

structural_cues: 36:41-44 runs continuously from carrying, through created likeness and riding, to danger, rescue, and mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a like-made transport medium that carries and a mercy that preserves; I infer a functional analogy in which same-kind humanity fits a messenger to carry speech among humans. The live alternative is that مثله refers only to conveyances and bears no social analogy to envoys.

changed_reading.before: A carrier like its recipients cannot bear a message from beyond them.
changed_reading.after: Likeness may be what fits a human carrier to convey mercy intelligibly among humans, just as a usable conveyance is made in a fitting likeness.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 36:47 the disbelievers invoke divine will to refuse human feeding: if God wished, He would feed directly. This repeats the focus's category error in another domain, treating divine agency and human mediation as mutually exclusive when provision can pass through commanded human expenditure.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary humanity is made incompatible with divine commissioning.
The speakers demand divine delivery without accepting a human delivery channel.
Human expenditure is the commanded mediating action.
The provision is already characterized as divine allotment before humans pass it on.
Feeding another is the concrete human act through which provision would reach its recipient.
Appeal to divine willing is used to cancel responsibility for mediated action.
The second exclusive verdict displays the same self-sealing argumentative form as 36:15.

structural_cues: 36:47 repeats the formula إن أنتم إلا and embeds a direct-versus-mediated divine agency argument.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divinely allotted provision, commanded expenditure, and refusal based on what God would do directly; I infer that this exposes the same anti-mediation logic as 36:15. The alternative is that 36:47 critiques stinginess alone, without reflecting on messenger mediation.

changed_reading.before: A divine sender would bypass ordinary humans, so human envoys disprove divine sending.
changed_reading.after: They falsely oppose divine agency to human mediation, just as they later deny that God's provision can reach someone through human hands.

context_deltas.mechanism: At awakening, a later human قول recognizes an event, the Merciful's promise, and the messengers' truth. Truth and falsehood cease to be competing labels in the village and become temporally verified relations between prior speech and realized event.

activation_trace.role: The envoys are assigned falsehood before the promised event is available.
A later articulated response revises the earlier human verdict.
The realized awakening supplies the event against which prior claims are tested.
A promise opens expectation toward a future fulfillment rather than immediate visible proof.
The same Merciful source denied in 36:15 is identified as promisor.
Fulfillment of word in event establishes the messengers' truth.
The commissioned speakers are explicitly reclassified as truthful.

structural_cues: 36:48 asks when the promise will occur if the envoys are truthful; 36:49-52 moves through the event to recognition of promise and truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an earlier liar verdict and a later event-linked truth verdict with the same Merciful source; I infer a temporal adjudication of 36:15. The later speakers need not be numerically identical to the villagers, so the reversal is surah-wide rather than biographical.

changed_reading.before: The envoys are liars because their claim lacks present visible realization.
changed_reading.after: Their speech is a promise whose truth-relation becomes manifest when the event arrives; present delay cannot by itself establish lying.

context_deltas.mechanism: 36:58 presents peace itself as a قول from a merciful Lord. A sourced speech-act can therefore be the form in which mercy reaches recipients, weakening the assumption that only a separately visible object could count as something from the Merciful.

activation_trace.role: Human articulated speech frames the denial.
Mercy is the source-domain from which the villagers deny any arrival.
Freedom from harm is the beneficial content realized by the speech.
An articulated utterance is itself the explicitly sourced medium.
Lordship supplies authoritative provenance for the utterance.
Merciful beneficence is expressed as speech reaching its hearers.

structural_cues: The compact nominal line in 36:58 directly joins peace, قول, source, lordship, and mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a beneficial قول explicitly from a merciful Lord; I infer that communicative provenance can satisfy the focus's denied from-Mercy relation. Alternatively, this may describe a direct paradisal reward rather than model mediated revelation.

changed_reading.before: Nothing from the Merciful exists unless a distinct object visibly descends.
changed_reading.after: A sourced saying can itself be the arrival and enactment of mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus trusts mouths to assign falsehood while reducing the envoys to human bodies; 36:65 seals mouths and makes hands speak and feet testify to embodied acquisition. The human body is not merely a surface that limits truth but can become a distributed evidentiary medium.

activation_trace.role: Mouth-like articulated speech currently controls the public verdict.
The body is initially reduced to its ordinary visible surface.
A securing seal disables the organ that issued unsupported verdicts.
The mouth's ordinary opening into speech is explicitly closed.
Intelligible speech shifts from mouth to hand.
The hand bears the acquired acts that its new speech discloses.
Testimony supplies evidence grounded in knowledge rather than accusation.
Feet become independent bodily witnesses.
What was actually acquired supplies the testimony's object.

structural_cues: 36:65 systematically redistributes speaking and witnessing across the same ordinary human body.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mouth-sealing and bodily testimony; I infer a reversal of 36:15's confidence in verbal status assignment and its reduction of humanity to surface. The scene may adjudicate deeds generally rather than the specific liar accusation.

changed_reading.before: Ordinary human embodiment is evidence against revelation, while our mouths can judge the envoys.
changed_reading.after: Human embodiment can carry truthful testimony beyond the mouth, and the accusers' verbal verdict is not the final evidentiary authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final human disputant emerges from a drop, strikes an analogy, and forgets his own creation; the answer restores first origination. This diagnoses the focus's مثلنا as a comparison of finished surfaces that suppresses the generative history making a human messenger possible at all.

activation_trace.role: The finished category human is treated as familiar and self-explanatory.
Present resemblance supplies the villagers' entire analogy.
The visible human is presented as an emerged form rather than a self-grounding type.
Creative origination supplies the omitted causal history.
A small fluid origin contrasts with the finished argumentative human.
The generated human becomes an open adversary who weaponizes comparison.
The disputant actively constructs and displays an analogy.
The analogy becomes an argumentative example rather than neutral resemblance.
Omission of creation identifies the mechanism by which the analogy misleads.
The forgotten creative process is precisely the missing comparator.
Origination reopens the causal process suppressed by surface comparison.
Firstness directs attention back before the finished human form.

structural_cues: 36:77-79 explicitly sequences human emergence, open dispute, analogy, forgetting creation, and restoration of first origination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later human analogy diagnosed by forgotten origin; I infer that this reveals the same defect in بشر مثلنا, namely comparing surfaces while deleting generative history. The immediate topic is resurrection, so transfer to messengerhood is a formal analogy rather than identical subject matter.

changed_reading.before: Shared finished human form is sufficient evidence that no divine commissioning occurred.
changed_reading.after: The comparison is defective because it treats human form as self-explanatory and forgets the originating power that can also commission and address humans.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close makes likeness an object of creation, a thing an object of will, and قول the causal transition into being; every thing then lies within sovereignty. The focus's chain is inverted: resemblance does not block divine agency, thinghood is not empty, and speech can enact rather than fabricate.

activation_trace.role: Likeness is initially used as evidence against divine action.
Thinghood is initially emptied under unrestricted negation.
Human speech initially functions as a denying verdict.
Repeated creation language encloses both prior cosmos and prospective likeness.
Effective capacity grounds the possibility of creating the like.
A likeness is now a possible product of divine creation rather than its negation.
Authoritative command supplies the directive force of the utterance.
Will selects the thing toward which command is directed.
The knowable item denied in the focus becomes the specified object of will.
Speech becomes an effective relation between will and realized being.
Commanded and realized occurrence display the causal result of the saying.
Sovereignty encloses the total domain in which things and likenesses arise.

structural_cues: 36:81-83 closes the surah with a tightly linked sequence of creating a like, willing a thing, saying, being, and sovereignty over every thing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact recurrences of likeness, thing, saying, and occurrence under creative power; I infer a deliberate lexical inversion of 36:15's ontology. The closing sequence is cosmological and may exceed the narrower question of how revelation is mediated.

changed_reading.before: Human likeness excludes divine sending, no thing has come, and messenger speech is fabrication.
changed_reading.after: Likeness itself can be divinely produced, a thing can be willed, and speech can be causally effective; none of the villagers' three premises excludes commissioning.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from بشر as human or exposed skin to بشارة as news that opens the skin with joy. It remains anchored in the identical ب ش ر root at the focus and 36:11, where unseen relation to the Merciful leads to بشّر. Downstream prose should present it as a root-image activation, not as a claim that the two forms are syntactically interchangeable.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's بشر at word 5 is activated by the same root's بشّر at 36:11 word 9.

activation_trace.role: Exposed human surface is the level at which the envoys are dismissed.
The effective source relation is hidden from eyes rather than absent.
News from the unseen reaches and visibly opens the human surface.
The Merciful source joins unseen reception to the surface-changing news.

changed_reading.before: Being بشر fixes the envoys inside an ordinary visible category.
changed_reading.after: The human surface dismissed as a limit is also the surface that news from the unseen can open and transform.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading links بشر as visible surface with 36:37's stripping of day from night. It remains anchored in the focus's surface branch and a context branch explicitly naming removal of a skin or covering. Downstream prose should qualify it as a material analogy for epistemic surface, not a lexical derivation of بشر from سلخ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: بشر at 36:15 word 5 supplies the exposed-surface anchor for the later stripping image.

activation_trace.role: The villagers infer total reality from the visible human surface.
Removing a skin-like layer reveals that the apparent surface was contingent.

changed_reading.before: Visible human sameness is the final layer of reality.
changed_reading.after: A visible layer can be stripped away to disclose a contrary underlying condition, so human surface alone cannot settle provenance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is branch-distant because it activates the رحم or womb image inside الرحمن and combines it with carrying, a drop, and origination. It remains anchored in the packet's own رحم branch and the focus's descent construction. Downstream prose should call it a contained receptivity model, not an etymological definition of the divine name or a claim that revelation is biological.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: الرحمن and أنزل in the focus permit an exploratory model of mercy causing content to lodge, develop, and emerge through an ordinary human medium.

activation_trace.role: The womb as a protected house of growth supplies a receptive interior behind visible humanity.
Arrival and lodging supply the movement into a receptive place.
Hidden carrying keeps live the possibility of content borne within an ordinary carrier.
A minute fluid beginning demonstrates emergence through embodied process.
Origination supplies the emergence of a new realized form from the hidden process.

changed_reading.before: Ordinary human embodiment makes reception from the Merciful impossible.
changed_reading.after: Ordinary embodiment may be a protected receptive medium through which mercy lodges, develops, and becomes communicable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material analogy is surprising because it carries the villagers' human-likeness argument into green wood producing fire. It remains anchored in بشر as judged surface and مثل as functional comparison, while 36:80 explicitly supplies the opposed material effect. Downstream prose should use it as an analogy against surface essentialism, not claim that envoys are directly symbolized by trees or fire.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus infers function from the visible surface of بشر and from resemblance; 36:80 supplies a surface whose apparent quality does not predict what it can carry or release.

activation_trace.role: Visible surface is assigned decisive evidentiary force.
Resemblance supports the rejected inference from appearance to capability.
The tree supplies the material carrier whose power is not obvious from its category.
Green living appearance creates the apparent opposition to fire.
Kindled fire is the unexpected effect borne by the green material.
Ignition realizes the latent capacity that surface classification missed.

changed_reading.before: A carrier's visible category fixes what can come through it.
changed_reading.after: A familiar surface can bear an apparently unlike effect, so ordinary human likeness does not determine the provenance or force of carried speech.

strongest_changes: The later bounded denial of a descending army corrects the focus's unrestricted no-descent claim by separating invisible commission from visible spectacle.
The loaded-vessel sequence turns likeness from a disqualifier into a property that can fit a carrier to those it carries.
The later recognition that the Merciful promised and the messengers spoke truth converts lying from an immediate status label into a relation tested by realized event.
The closing sequence makes likeness creatable, a thing willable, and saying causally effective, reversing the focus's full chain of assumptions.
The final human disputant exposes surface analogy as defective when it forgets the human's own generated origin.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence does not merely contradict the villagers. It repeatedly preserves their exact roots and argumentative shapes, then changes scope or function: no descent becomes bounded, likeness becomes carriage and creation, قول becomes promise and effective command, بشر becomes a receptive surface, and شيء moves from erased content to the object of exhaustive knowledge and will.
remaining_uncertainties: The transport, celestial-station, bodily-testimony, and green-tree mechanisms are formal analogies; the packet does not state that they directly symbolize messenger mediation.
The outer parable's مَثَل clearly frames the inner مِثْلُنَا, but the degree of intentional root-level reflexivity remains uncertain.
The womb and skin-opening activations are deliberately exploratory branch-image readings and should not be promoted to lexical definitions.
The obstruction imagery may describe a consequence of refusal rather than the causal source of the villagers' verdict.
